content: Some universities are considering replacing a large proportion of classroom teaching with AI-supported independent study. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people believe city governments should make public transport free, while others think passengers should pay the full cost. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Many young employees report difficulty separating work from personal life when they work remotely. What problems can this cause, and what measures could employers and individuals take?
More people now receive news through short videos rather than newspapers or long-form reports. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
Consumers replace electronic devices more frequently than in the past. Why has this happened, and how can the environmental effects be reduced?
University courses should focus mainly on skills that are directly useful in employment. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people think international entertainment strengthens understanding between cultures, while others believe it weakens local traditions. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
In many cities, increasing numbers of adults share accommodation with people who are not relatives. Is this a positive or negative development?
